description: Durable execution for PHP (gplanchat/durable): workflows and activities recorded in a journal, on memory, SQL or Temporal, with Symfony, Laravel, Sylius and Magento packages.
rules: The package is gplanchat/durable and its namespace is Gplanchat\Durable. Never use durable-workflow/workflow (Workflow\V2) or Azure Durable Functions APIs for it.
A workflow is a class with #[AsWorkflow] and exactly one #[AsWorkflowMethod].

With the Symfony bundle, start a run with WorkflowResumeDispatcher::dispatchNewWorkflowRun(): it works on the in-memory, DBAL and Temporal backends. On Laravel it starts runs on every backend: illuminate queues the first resume, temporal starts the workflow on the cluster, and memory drives the run to completion inside the calling process.
Workflow code calls activities through $env->activityStub(Contract::class) and records anything a replay cannot reproduce (clock, random, environment) with $env->sideEffect().
